name: gymos-mobile
description: Android and iOS wrappers for GymOS (Capacitor). The app itself lives in ../public.

scripts.web: bash ../build.sh && rm -rf www && mkdir www && cp -r ../public/. www/ && rm -f www/sw.js www/offline.html
scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android
scripts.ios:add: npx cap add ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
